# Article I. DEFINITIONS

<!-- pdf-page: 28 -->
## Section 1. Definitions

Terms in this section apply throughout the agreement.
<!-- pdf-page: 29 -->
(z) “Extension” means a longer contract.
(ll) “Minimum Team Salary” means the Article VII amount.
<!-- pdf-page: 30 -->
(rr) “Non-Qualifying Veteran Free Agent” means a veteran who is neither.
(yy) “Qualifying Veteran Free Agent” means three seasons with the prior team.
<!-- pdf-page: 35 -->
(uuu) “Team Salary” means the sum
of salaries that continues on the next line without a period yet.

(i) Included amounts are listed in this sub-paragraph.

This sentence continues Team Salary and must stay whole even though it runs past the budget without an interior stop.
